items.item_text: High school diploma and/or equivalent experience / training
Minimum of 5 years of dedicated executive support experience reporting directly to C-suite level leadership
Experience working at an academic medical institution or higher education environment.
Experience working in an executive-level office and providing high-level administrative support to executive leadership.
Experience coordinating conferences/meetings and special events.
Proven experience managing complex, executive-level electronic calendars.
Experience working in a confidential environment with demonstrated understanding of HIPAA standards.

Under supervision of the Executive Assistant and in direct partnership with the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) the incumbent provides high-level administrative support to the Vice President, Financial Planning and Analyst (VP-FP&A), and office level support for the management teams under the direction of the VP-FP&A. The incumbent is expected to utilize initiative, judgment and discretion in researching, analyzing and compiling necessary background information to assist executive leadership and support staff in responding to a wide variety of issues; research and initiate an array of correspondence on behalf of executive leadership; independently assume responsibility for issues that do not require the involvement of executive leadership; apply problem ­solving techniques to resolve various situations; and provide referrals to appropriate offices and authorities.

The position requires technical proficiency in multiple software, office hardware and computer systems. As principal calendar, project and communication support to the VP-F&A, the incumbent responds through verbal and/or written communication to a wide variety of inquiries from faculty, staff, the public and the highest levels of the UC system (e.g., Campus and University administration, Chancellor’s Office, and the Offices of the President and the Regents). Assignments may also include calendaring for management (Directors, Managers and Supervisors) within the VP-FP&A team. The position researches requests for meetings and helps to track an array of correspondence; manages complex calendars to determine priorities of meetings and resolve scheduling conflicts; and handles all aspects of travel arrangement and reimbursement. Incumbent partners with counterparts throughout UC Davis and UC Davis Health to fulfill daily operations, as needed. #CA-DS
Demonstrated political acumen and discretion in maintaining confidentiality.
High degree of proficiency using Outlook Calendar and Microsoft Office (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and diplomacy to handle sensitive and/or difficult situations.
Knowledge of UC Davis and UC Davis Health policies and procedures.
Demonstrated project management skills to balance competing deadlines and successfully support multiple meetings and projects.
Knowledge of UC Davis and UC Davis Health specific programs (AggieTravel, Aggie Service, IT Service Now, Conference Services, Aggie Enterprise, Lawson, BEATS, UC Path, JobBuilder, etc.).
Demonstrated organizational and analytical skills to independently manage complex projects and events.
Strong time management and multi-tasking skills.
Strong analytical, research and problem-solving skills.
Excellent typing, writing, editing and proofreading skills to produce correspondence and other written materials.
